player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Blackjack nedealer.
Inhloso yakho kukhona kudlula 21 ngisho lapha ngaphambi kweminyaka.
Ngesikhathi sakho, khetha '[Hit]' ukudlula karcidi noma '[Stand]' ukuthula.
J/Q/K = 10 iphoyinti; A = 11 noma 1, ngokuba kukhona okuhle.
